description: P35 (plan M6-M9 §5.4, §5.7): two trolls squat in the wrecked woodcutters' camp on the Woodway (the quest starts when the giant finds the camp or comes within 150 m of it). The camp's bonfire and brazier teach fire (tutorial.troll_fire): clear the trolls (150 XP), then take the woodcutters' greataxe from its rack (weapon.axe).

stages.objective: Drive the trolls out of the woodcutters' camp
stages.waiting_text: Trolls close their wounds unless they burn: smash the bonfire or the brazier beside one.

stages.objective: Take the woodcutters' greataxe from its rack
